This breakthrough demonstrates AI's growing ability to handle strategic games with limited visibility. The AI's success highlights advancements in combining traditional search methods with modern learning techniques, overcoming previous limitations. The development could have broader implications for AI in strategic decision-making tasks.

items.title: Court agrees with EFF: Utah's VPN law demands a technical impossibility
items.contentSnippet:
Article URL: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/10/court-agrees-eff-utahs-vpn-law-demands-technical-impossibility
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49927754
Points: 776
# Comments: 381
items.creator: hn_acker

summaries.zh: 法院支持电子前沿基金会观点：犹他州VPN法案要求的技术方案不可能实现。该法案规定VPN服务商需记录用户活动日志，但法院裁定此要求违反技术规范，因VPN协议设计初衷即保护用户隐私，无法实现记录功能。判决维护了VPN服务商的合法权益，确保用户数据安全。
summaries.en: A U.S. court ruled that Utah's VPN law is unconstitutional because it requires VPN providers to break encryption and monitor user activity, which is technically impossible. The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) supported the ruling, arguing that such demands violate privacy rights and the law's purpose. The court agreed, finding the law unenforceable and invalid. The decision highlights the conflict between privacy laws and encryption standards.
